            30. Hedge accounting                                                             30. 套期會計
                  (1)   Basis of hedge accounting and accounting treatment                       (1)   採用套期會計的依據與會
                                                                                                       計處理方法
                        To manage the risk exposure caused by specific risks such                      為管理外匯風險、利率風險等

                        has designated certain financial instruments as hedging                        集團指定某些金融工具作為套

                        hedges and cash flow hedges. For the hedges for foreign                        期包括公允價值套期、現金流

                        as cash flow hedges.                                                           險進行的套期，本集團作為現

                  Value-added tax (VAT)                   1、 For the Group’s PRC subsidiaries, output VAT is calculated by applying
                  增值稅                                          13%, 9% and 6% to the taxable income for normal taxpayers, but the
                                                               Group may pay it after deducting deductible input VAT for the current
                                                               period.
                                                               本集團境內子公司一般納稅人按應稅收入的13%、9%、6%的稅率
                                                               計算銷項稅，並按扣除當期允許抵扣的進項稅額後的差額計繳增值

Emolument Policy                                                                      薪酬政策
The Group is strictly in compliance with laws and regulations such as the Labour      本集團認真貫徹落實中國《勞動法》、《勞動合同
Law and the Labour Contract Law of the PRC, and formulates a remuneration             法》等法律法規，並結合企業發展戰略、行業特
system and incentive policies that suit the actual situation of the enterprise by     點和人工成本支付能力，制定切合企業實際的薪
combining the development strategy of the enterprise, the characteristics of the      酬制度和激勵政策。
industry and the ability to pay for labour costs.


The Group adopts a differentiated and standardised annual salary system               本集團根據管理、研發、生產工人等不同崗位序
and a non-annual salary system according to different job positions such as           列，分別採取差異化、規範化的年薪制和非年薪
management, research and development and production, where the non-annual             制薪酬制度，其中非年薪制又細分為崗位績效工
salary system is subdivided into salary systems such as performance-based salary      資制、計（時）件工資制、班產量日工資制度等薪
system, piece-rate (hourly) salary system and shift production daily salary system.   酬制度。


By evaluating the position value of all kinds of personnel and referencing the        通過對各類人員進行崗位價值評估和對標市場薪
market remuneration level, we have set the salary standard with competitive           酬水平，制定具備競爭優勢的薪酬標準，合理
advantages by reasonably setting the salary level hierarchy of personnel,             設定人員薪酬等級層級，確定以崗定薪級、以績
determining the salary level by position and the salary distribution plan by          效定薪酬分配方案，並依據績效考評實施薪酬升
performance, and adjusting the salary according to the performance appraisal,         降，突出對研發、營銷、工匠等重點崗位人才的
increasing the incentives for talents in key positions such as research and           激勵力度。同時，實施創新項目、專利專項、管
development, marketing and technical staffs. At the same time, we have                理創新等激勵機制和駐外崗位、員工住房等補貼
implemented incentive mechanisms for innovation projects, patent specialisation,      辦法，建立健全了促進企業高質量快速發展的薪
management innovation and other subsidies for overseas positions and staff            酬激勵政策。
housing, and established a sound salary incentive policy to promote high-quality
and rapid development of enterprises.


The emoluments of the directors of the Company are decided by the                     本公司董事的薪酬由薪酬委員會經考慮本集團經
Remuneration Committee, having regard to the Group’s operating results,               營業績、個人表現及可資比較市場統計數據後決
individual performance and comparable market statistics.                              定。
